He tucked the note into his coat, climbed the spiral stairs, and lit the lamp with steadier hands.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还在沉睡，街灯把空荡的马路照成一条安静的河。便利店的灯光孤独地亮着，收银员打着哈欠。偶尔一辆出租车驶过，轮胎碾过潮湿的路面。早起的清洁工推着车，扫帚划过地面，发出沙沙的声响。天边泛起一丝灰蓝，鸟还没醒，风却先来了。这是属于夜与昼交界的时刻，城市短暂地属于它自己。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something solves a big problem by doing a tiny bit, then asking a smaller copy of itself to do the rest.\n• It keeps shrinking the problem until it is so small the answer is obvious, like counting down to zero.\n• Think of standing between two mirrors: each reflection shows a smaller one inside, again and again."}
